name: date-picker
title: Date Picker
description: A date picker component with range and presets.

files.content:
Date Picker

Single

data-np-date-picker on an empty element. It builds the trigger, the popover and the calendar.

Range

data-mode="range".

Date of birth

data-caption-layout="dropdown".

Input

data-editable adds a text field. Type a date, or press the arrow down key to open the calendar.

Date and time

Next to another field.

Limits

Calendar options pass through: data-min, data-max, data-disabled-weekdays.

In a form

data-name adds a hidden input with the ISO value.

Value: -

Event

A nepui:datepickerchange event fires on every change.

Nothing picked.
